source_row.stem: During a facility-wide outbreak of a contagious respiratory illness, temporary visitor restrictions may be implemented to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Apply only to visitors with symptoms, with no other restriction","B":"Have no relationship to infection control","C":"Reduce the risk of further transmission to vulnerable clients and staff","D":"Punish families with no clinical benefit"}}
source_row.rationale: Temporary visitor restrictions during an outbreak are implemented to reduce the risk of further transmission to vulnerable clients and staff, an infection control measure used during periods of increased outbreak risk.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Visitor Policy During Outbreak Response
